prompt: All three forecast sources returned errors for a market. What does the run look like and what happens next?
expected_output: fetch_all sets all_sources_failed=true for that market, records last_error on each adapter, signal-gen still emits a signal for the market (with the partial data it has from p_market only) but trade=false by definition, and risk-manage's all_sources_failed check fires a soft anomaly if it persists >1h.

assertions.name: all_sources_failed_flag
assertions.description: Output must set all_sources_failed=true when all sources fail

assertions.name: records_last_error
assertions.description: Output must record the error per adapter

assertions.name: downstream_signal_handling
assertions.description: Output must explain the downstream effect on signal-gen and risk-manage

assertions.name: writes_forecasts_json
assertions.description: Output must show the fetch_all result shape with the market's data
